newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chrysler Q2, '97 EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chrysler Q2, '97 EPS cut.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston analyst Nicholas Colas on Thursday cut his second quarter earnings estimate for Chrysler Corp to $0.70 a share from $0.90 because of expected higher retail incentives in the U.S.
-- Incentives for the quarter are now estimated to be $950 per vehicle from the previous forecast of $840.

--Colas said he also cut his 1997 full year estimate to $4.35 from $4.55. First Boston is maintaining its "buy" recommendation because of Chrysler's ability to turn a profit at strike-reduced production levels and higher incentives.
-- Chrysler closed dowqn 3/8 at 32-3/8 on the New York Stoick Exchange.
